summary: A suspend whose first stop timed out while the harness was still exiting no longer reports the seat failed when it completes: the stale stop fault clears before the suspended phase is recorded

replay.detail: Uses the existing member-recovered reconcile decision; replay of existing claims is unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or API change; the claim kinds and fields are the ones already written a pass later.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
